decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first floor to existing bungalow to create a two-storey 6-bedroom detached house, by reason of its size, position and design, would result in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity to the neighbouring property to the south, by reason of loss of light, loss of outlook and enclosure to an adjoining first floor habitable room window, which currently provides the sole source of natural light to a bedroom. The proposal is therefore contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.4.

Condition : 2 - The resultant two-storey 6-bedroom detached house, would fail to provide the Council's minimum private amenity space provision, which would be detrimental to the residential amenities of the future occupants of the proposed family accommodation, contrary to UDP policies H.1.1 and H.4.1.
description: Erection of first floor to existing bungalow to create detached 2 storey dwellinghouse
